segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The ground support plan for that stope had been signed off about four months earlier... We let day shift go in and start drilling as scheduled.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant defaults to the unrevised support plan despite above-baseline microseismic events and available inspection alternatives.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The model came back with a 2.3... Stope 9 was just the one that was fresh in my head... I authorized the afternoon blast clearance.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant treats a precise model rating as settled despite a known blind spot and relies on one vivid prior event instead of broader comparison.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I leaned toward the crew's read... The inspector's note got filed... because the Stope 9 comparison made the pattern seem like something we already understood.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant treats similarity to one prior crack pattern as validating and selectively transmits reassuring reports while sidelining dissent.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: That rock fall didn't worry me much... it read to me as consistent with... minor settling... Twenty years gives you a feel for these things... I authorized the blast.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant interprets a minor rock fall as consistent with stability and expresses high confidence despite sensor lag and unresolved warning signs.

segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: obs_003 is matched to cb_01 because its full mechanism is selective transmission and sidelining of dissent; the separate case-pattern illusion-of-validity instance iv_02 is not identified.

segment_level_adjudications.adjudication_note: obs_004 matches ob_01 through its self-certainty mechanism; the distinct belief-consistent interpretation instance cb_02 is not identified.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Morning decision to continue under the existing ground support plan
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Default retention of the existing ground support plan despite new seismic evidence, without substantive re-evaluation.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: The proposed candidate label exactly matches the hidden target label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The quote and proposed mechanism capture retaining the approved plan because changing it after three events felt unnecessarily disruptive; the candidate is cautious because legitimate non-bias explanations remain plausible.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The supporting quote is faithful to the interview and localizes to dp1.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Numeric hazard rating and afternoon blast clearance
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Overweighting the precision of a numeric hazard rating despite a known monitoring blind spot.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Anchoring is a neighboring but non-equivalent construct; the prediction names the influence of the numeric rating but not the hidden illusion-of-validity label.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding fully captures treating the precise 2.3 rating as settled and failing to adjust for the known blind spot.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quote is valid, directly tied to the participant, and faithfully represents the dp2 reasoning.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Inferring strong predictive confidence from similarity to a single past case and treating that narrative coherence as proof the current pattern is benign.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: No RAG finding is assigned to the case-pattern coherence mechanism in dp3.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: Not applicable because there is no prediction.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Selective transmission of crew reports and sidelining of the inspector note
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Selective forwarding of belief-consistent crew reports while filing away, without escalation, the dissenting inspector note.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: The label is an exact target-label match.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding captures both favoring the reassuring crew view and withholding the conflicting inspector recommendation.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quoted evidence is valid and faithfully localizes the selective reporting act to dp3.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Interpreting the minor rock fall as confirmation of stability
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Interpreting an ambiguous new rock fall as confirming a prior belief rather than as a reason to reassess.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: No RAG finding separately identifies the belief-consistent interpretation of the rock fall in dp4.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: Not applicable because there is no prediction.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Final scheduled blast with sensor lag and a small rock fall
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Expressed high personal certainty despite an unresolved sensor gap and unaddressed dissenting evidence.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Overconfidence effect is an established equivalent label for Overconfidence Bias in this context.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding directly captures high confidence substituting for missing sensor confirmation despite unresolved uncertainty.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The quotes are valid and faithfully represent the final decision episode.

instance_level_adjudications.hidden_decision_or_episode: Using the salient Stope 9 precedent to judge the current hazard rating
instance_level_adjudications.hidden_mechanism: Risk judgment driven by one vivid recalled event rather than broader base-rate evidence.
instance_level_adjudications.label_equivalence_explanation: Availability heuristic is an established equivalent label for Availability Bias.
instance_level_adjudications.mechanism_overlap_explanation: The finding precisely identifies reliance on the one fresh Stope 9 memory instead of a broader comparison.
instance_level_adjudications.evidence_fidelity_assessment: The two quoted passages are valid and directly support the hidden availability mechanism in dp2.

unmatched_rag_predictions.why_not_an_exact_strict_match: The finding is localized correctly and fully describes the numeric-rating mechanism, but it reports anchoring bias instead of the hidden Illusion of validity label.

candidates.details: The candidate has the exact target label, correct dp1 localization, and a substantially complete default-retention mechanism. Its cautious status reflects the legitimate possibility that the manager reasonably relied on the approved plan and absence of visible damage.

high_only.detection_interpretation: Only dp2 is detected at high confidence, through the availability finding; dp1, dp3, and dp4 are missed.

high_and_moderate.detection_interpretation: dp2, dp3, and dp4 are detected; dp1 remains a miss because status quo bias is only a candidate.

all_identified_confidence_levels.detection_interpretation: Low-confidence identified findings add no detections; the result is identical to high_and_moderate.

all_confidence_and_candidates.detection_interpretation: The cautious status quo candidate adds the missing dp1 detection without introducing a false alarm.

rag_label_false_positive_inventory.mechanism_overlap_summary: Full overlap with the hidden numeric-model precision mechanism, but the taxonomy label is a neighboring construct.

corpus_support_audit.assessment_note: The RAG explicitly states that no retrieved corpus passages were supplied and provides no citation metadata. Corpus support therefore does not affect the primary scores.

confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_to_high_and_moderate: Segment hits rise from 1 to 3; strict instance F1 rises from 0.25 to 0.5455 and mechanism-first F1 from 0.25 to 0.7273.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_high_and_moderate_to_all_: No change: no low-confidence identified finding is present.
confidence_tradeoff.increment_from_all_confidence_to_all_con: The status quo candidate adds one segment hit and one strict and mechanism-first true positive, with no additional false alarm.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, 3 of 4 positive reasoning segments are detected with no false alarms.
overall_evaluation_summary.strict_label_plus_mechanism_result: At high_and_moderate, strict matching yields 3 true positives, 4 false negatives, and 1 false positive (precision 0.75, recall 0.4286, F1 0.5455).
overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, mechanism-first matching yields 4 true positives, 3 false negatives, and no false positives (precision 1, recall 0.5714, F1 0.7273).
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The single status quo candidate is a useful abstention and becomes a true positive at the candidate-inclusive threshold, recovering the only missed segment without a false alarm.
main_failure_modes: The RAG misses both illusion-of-validity occurrences as the hidden label, although it describes the numeric-model mechanism under the neighboring anchoring label.
It misses the confirmation-bias occurrence involving belief-consistent interpretation of the minor rock fall.
It identifies only one of the two hidden confirmation-bias occurrences.
main_strengths: The availability finding is a high-confidence, exact mechanism and approved-label match.
The selective-reporting confirmation finding is correctly localized and mechanistically complete.
The overconfidence finding is correctly localized and uses an established equivalent label with faithful evidence.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: The run shows strong segment-level detection at moderate-inclusive confidence but incomplete ontology-level coverage. A mechanism-first scorecard materially improves performance because the numeric-model prediction captures the hidden mechanism despite using a neighboring label; candidate-inclusive scoring further recovers the subtle status quo instance.
